title: Portfolio5 exact‑accept SA (5×90s) + 360s active‑pair polish
abstract: Runs five exact‑accept SA restarts (90s each) with distinct seeds, selects the best by Σr, then applies a 360s constraint‑aware backtracking quench along tight pair/boundary directions (exact LP objective). Deterministic seed list.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import sa_lp_exact_params as P
import active_quench as AQ

def construct_packing():
    seeds = [20251021, 20251022, 20251023, 20251024, 20251025]
    per_run = 90.0   # seconds per seed
    polish  = 360.0  # active-pair backtracking quench

    best_ctrs = None
    best_r = None
    best_S = -1.0
    best_seed = None

    for sd in seeds:
        ctrs, r, S = P.exact_sa_params(
            budget_sec=per_run,
            seed=sd,
            step0=0.035,
            ar_lo=0.15, ar_hi=0.30,
            quench_interval=12.0, quench_tries=60,
            margins=(0.04, 0.06),
            two_phase=True,
            step_minmax_phase1=(0.005, 0.08),
            step_minmax_phase2=(0.004, 0.04),
        )
        if S > best_S:
            best_S, best_ctrs, best_r, best_seed = S, ctrs, r, sd

    # Polish best centers with constraint-aware backtracking quench
    ctrs_f, r_f, S_f = AQ.active_pair_quench(best_ctrs, budget_sec=polish, seed=best_seed+100)

    # Validity checks
    assert ctrs_f.shape == (26,2)
    assert r_f.shape == (26,)
    assert np.all(r_f > 0)
    x, y = ctrs_f[:,0], ctrs_f[:,1]
    b = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1-x, y, 1-y])
    assert np.all(r_f <= b + 1e-9)

    return ctrs_f, r_f
